article_title: OpenTelemetry 观测 .NET RAG 的耗时与成本
core_theme: 用 OpenTelemetry 把 .NET RAG 管线从一次不透明的「AI 请求」拆成同一 trace 下可归因的阶段 span，并只记录元数据
reader_takeaway: 知道该在嵌入、检索、重排、拼装提示词、生成这些边界上建 span，以及为什么只带版本标识和有界计数而不带内容
summary_angle: 一个密封的黑匣被点亮成五段可辨识的机构：每段都显出自己的耗时与计数，而旁边的账册只刻数字与版本，不抄录内容

information_blocks.source_anchor: 开头：一条「AI 请求 2.3 秒」的聚合指标把五个不同的失败原因压成同一个数字
information_blocks.visual_idea: 一块沉重、无接缝的密封黑色立方体
黑匣被拆成五段用光线连接的等距机构，每段都能单独看清

information_blocks.source_anchor: 契约表：只允许非负整数、布尔值与有界长度作为属性
information_blocks.visual_idea: 每一段机构上方挂着一块只显示刻度与状态的铭牌

information_blocks.source_anchor: 遥测最小化：查询文本、提示词、检索片段、用户标识都不进通用遥测
information_blocks.visual_idea: 旁侧一本上锁的账册，页面上只有刻痕与记号，没有文字内容

main_metaphor: 暗室里的机构被逐段点亮：原本一体的黑匣显出五段可归因的关节，旁边只留一本刻着数字与版本的账册
primary_subject: 一个被拆成五段的等距机械装置，代表 RAG 管线的五个阶段
subject_action: 被逐节点亮，每一段显出自己的刻度铭牌，冷光沿连接线依次传递

final_prompt:
Use case: infographic-story
Asset type: wide cover infographic illustration for a Chinese tech blog article
Primary request: Create a wide cinematic infographic-story cover illustration that summarizes the article. Theme: using OpenTelemetry to break a .NET RAG pipeline out of one opaque "AI request" into separately attributable stage spans, while recording metadata only. The reader should quickly feel that a sealed black box is opened up and each stage becomes individually visible.

Summary angle: a heavy seamless black cube is revealed as five connected isometric machine segments, each lit in turn so its own dial and state become readable, with a locked ledger beside it that carries only marks and numbers.
Narrative flow: layered reveal. In a 2.35:1 frame, keep one dominant focal subject and 4 supporting narrative beats. Each beat must map to the article's information blocks rather than generic decoration.
Information blocks:
- problem: a heavy seamless sealed black cube sits in shadow; visible label 黑盒请求
- mechanism: the cube opens into five linked isometric machine segments joined by thin light lines, each segment readable on its own; visible label 分阶段追踪
- evidence: a small bolted plaque above each segment shows only a dial and a state mark; visible label 有界计数
- takeaway (with label): a locked ledger with pages of carved marks and numerals but no written content; visible label 不记内容

Main metaphor: a dark chamber where a single sealed machine is lit segment by segment, so every joint becomes attributable while the ledger keeps only counts and revisions.
Subject: an isometric mechanism split into five distinct segments, the dominant focal object.
Composition/framing: isometric three-quarter view, the five segments running diagonally across the frame, the locked ledger as a secondary object in the lower right foreground. One clear focal point, wide and legible.
Style/medium: combine isometric conceptual systems scene with the selected visual style descriptor: dark gothic illustration, pointed arches, lace shadows, candlelit contrast, ornate black shapes, restrained horror mood. Stylized, polished, editorial, visually strong, and clearly readable as an infographic-style summary cover. Do not imitate a specific brand, studio, or living artist.
Color palette: ink black, candlelit amber, cold stone grey, deep violet shadow.
Visible text policy: allow only these 4 short Chinese chips, each on one carved plate: 黑盒请求, 分阶段追踪, 有界计数, 不记内容. No poster title, no long sentences, no English slogans, no code text, no fake UI labels, no fake chart axes, no fake terminal output.
Constraints: no watermark, no prompt residue, no screenshots, no dashboards, no fake diagrams, no fake charts, no fabricated metrics, no unrelated icon collage, no decorative clutter.
Avoid: English slogans, fake terminal output, fabricated axes or charts, skulls or gore, neon colors, meaningless code rain, floating chips, generic robots, dense HUD overlays.
